728-2440-3490.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
728-2440-3490.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing another creature, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Servo on the battlefield.
Repeat.
728-2440-3490.notes: If there is at least one other Servo on the battlefield to start the combo, this combo nets infinite colorless mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-6791-8139.easyPrerequisites: Scepter of Celebration is attached to a creature you control other than the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
3259-6791-8139.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-6791-8139.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and the creature that has Scepter of Celebration attached, triggering Breath of Fury and Scepter of Celebration.
Resolve the Scepter of Celebration trigger, creating a number of 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a Citizen token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

277-5531-5694-6991-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-5531-5694-6991-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Donnie & April and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Donnie & April and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Donnie & April trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-5531-5694-6991-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Donnie & April and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

3764-4247-4871.description:
Activate Summoning Station by tapping it, creating a 2/2 Pincher creature token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Pincher.
When the Pincher dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Summoning Station triggers, untapping it.
Repeat.

1981-2292-2415-7818.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2292-2415-7818.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

1874-1981-2415-2438.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1874-1981-2415-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Ajani's Welcome triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

757-1446-2348-5087.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-1446-2348-5087.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Viral Drake to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Nature's Revolt, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

851-2557-5478-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Spelunking.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat
851-2557-5478-7824-7942.notes: An infinite card draw result has been added to this combo due to Cultivator Colossus or a similar card. This likely limits the other results based on the number of cards in your library.

2577-5670-7492.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
2577-5670-7492.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Arnyn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Goblin, Orc or Army Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

2511-4871-5220-7855--180.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the Goblin, Orc or Army
When the Goblin, Orc or Army dies, Pitiless Plunderer, The Great Goblin's second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the Goblin, Orc or Army onto the top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Great Goblin trigger, exiling the Goblin, Orc or Army from the top of your library with the ability to play it until the end of your next turn.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the Goblin, Orc or Army from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat

2104-7370-7487.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Zealous Lorecaster.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Zealous Lorecaster from exile to the battlefield.
When Zealous Lorecaster enters, it triggers, returning Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.

765-1558-3875-4231-7810.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1558-3875-4231-7810.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Tippy-Toe.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

2685-2919-3197-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2685-2919-3197-7810.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-3504-5400.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-3504-5400.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Synth Infiltrator and Mercurial Pretender each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Mercurial Pretender trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-3504-5400.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

443-1580-4871-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Magus of the Bridge trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

129-206-1409-4289.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Kinnan triggers, adding {U}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

215-1879-5614.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-1879-5614.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

3446-3532-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3446-3532-5078-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-7175-7278.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7175-7278.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Slash as attackers.
Slash's second ability triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Slash's first ability triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3809-4682-5140-6753.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
3809-4682-5140-6753.description:
Activate Kenrith's fourth ability by paying {3}{U}, causing an opponent who cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger to draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers, causing you to create two Treasure tokens due to Exalted Sunborn.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{U}{U} due to Goldspan Dragon.
Repeat.
3809-4682-5140-6753.notes: Eventually the opponent will lose the game due to drawing from an empty library. You can repeat this loop with other opponents that also cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.

930-2981-6871-6879.description:
Cast Universal Automaton by paying {1}.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Universal Automaton.
When Universal Automaton dies, Haru triggers, returning Universal Automaton from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Universal Automaton enters, Haru triggers, targeting Universal Automaton as it is a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

549-1978-4747.notablePrerequisites: You had a creature with power 3 or greater enter the battlefield this turn.
549-1978-4747.description:
Activate Alena by tapping it, adding at least {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Alena.
Repeat

465-6132-6797.description:
Cast Wormfang Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Wormfang Drake.
When Wormfang Drake dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Wormfang Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Wormfang Drake enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1003-2034-2173-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Phyrexian Walker from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

2034-3234-3293-5411.easyPrerequisites: You control a Plains or have a Plains in your graveyard.
2034-3234-3293-5411.description:
Activate Need for Speed by sacrificing a land.
Repeat step 1 until you control no lands.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing World Shaper.
When World Shaper dies, it triggers, return all lands from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the lands enter, Emeria Shepherd triggers that many times.
Resolve an Emeria Shepherd trigger that was triggered by a Plains, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve all remaining Emeria Shepherd triggers.
Repeat
2034-3234-3293-5411.notes: You can return all nonland permanents in your graveyard and library to the battlefield if you control there are two or more Plains between your graveyard, library and battlefield. To do this, have all triggers from Emeria Shepherd target desired permanents. Then, resolve the Plains triggers first to return those cards to the battlefield, causing all other triggers to fizzle on the stack.

4423-4872-6701-6886.easyPrerequisites:
You control three other Islands.
There is another nonbasic land on the battlefield.
4423-4872-6701-6886.description:
Cast Time Warp by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Dust Bowl by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Mystic Sanctuary, destroying a nonbasic land.
Play Mystic Sanctuary from your graveyard.
When Mystic Sanctuary enters untapped, it triggers, putting Time Warp from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Warp during your draw step.
Repeat.

2178-3817-6542-6798.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
2178-3817-6542-6798.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

1052-5147-6553.easyPrerequisites: Minion's Return attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
1052-5147-6553.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Brotherhood Outcast.
When Brotherhood Outcast dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Brotherhood Outcast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Brotherhood Outcast enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Brotherhood Outcast.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

183-2634-5148.notablePrerequisites: You control a basic Mountain, a basic Island and at least three other basic lands.
183-2634-5148.description:
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Early Harvest by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Early Harvest
Resolve the Early Harvest copy, untapping all basic lands you control.
Activate any number of basic lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 3.

5189-5231-5439-6441.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
5189-5231-5439-6441.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {R}.
Repeat.

3495-5909.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature that does not have summoning sickness.
3495-5909.description:
Cast Doomsday Excruciator by paying {B}{B}{B}{B}{B}{B}.
When Doomsday Excruciator enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling all but the bottom six cards of each library face down.
Cast Breach the Multiverse by paying {5}{B}{B}, causing each player to mill ten cards, thus milling the remainder of each player's library.
When your opponents go to draw a card during their next draw steps, they will lose the game due to attempting to draw from an empty library.

165-1069-2079-5499.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least three artifacts.
You have at least one experience counter.
165-1069-2079-5499.description:
Activate Daxos the Returned by paying {1}{W}{B}, creating a */* Spirit creature token.
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0} due to Puresteel Paladin, attaching it to the Spirit.
Activate the Spirit by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}{W}{W} or {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

1170-3389-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {W}{W}.
1170-3389-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {W}{W}.
Cast Flickering Ward by paying its mana cost, targeting Displacer Kitten
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Peregrine Drake.
When Peregrine Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to five lands.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1339-1818-4279.notablePrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You control at least one additional creature.
1339-1818-4279.description:
Activate Yawgmoth's first ability by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, causing you to draw a card and allowing you to put a -1/-1 counter on up to one creature.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
When the Insect enters the battlefield, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

3484-4374-5666.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
3484-4374-5666.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Decoction Module triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

2867-4050-4636-5391.description:
Activate Automated Assembly Line by paying {E}{E}{E}, creating a 3/3 Robot artifact creature token.
When the Robot enters the battlefield, Gonti's Aether Heart triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Robot, adding one mana of any color.
When the Robot dies, Demon of Dark Schemes' second ability triggers, causing you to get {E}.
Repeat.

413-1684-2178-2757.notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Rakka Mar.
You control at least one basic Mountain.
413-1684-2178-2757.description:
Activate a basic Mountain by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Rakka Mar by paying {R} and tapping it, creating a 3/1 Elemental creature token with haste.
When the Elemental enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Elemental, untapping the Mountain.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Elemental.
When the Elemental dies, Rakka Mar triggers, untapping Rakka Mar.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2-338-1496-5296.notablePrerequisites: Light of Promise attached to Workhorse.
2-338-1496-5296.description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it and Verdant Sun's Avatar trigger.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life equal to Ancestral Statue's toughness.
Workhorse triggers, putting four +1/+1 counters on itself.
Activate Workhorse four times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

611-1339-1636-4091.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {4}.
611-1339-1636-4091.description:
Activate all mana-producing creatures you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}.
Activate The Celestus by paying {3} and tapping it, changing it from day to night or from night to day.
The Celestus triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and loot.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, untapping The Celestus.
Repeat.

411-3263-3593.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {1} and returning it to your hand, adding {3}.
Activate Sneak Attack by paying {1}, putting Grinning Ignus from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2754-4865.notablePrerequisites:
Brine Elemental is face up.
Vesuvan Shapeshifter is face down.
2754-4865.description:
Turn Vesuvan Shapeshifter face-up for {1}{U}.
As it turns face up, have it copy Brine Elemental, triggering Brine Elemental's face-up ability.
Resolve the ability; each opponent skips their next untap step.
Pass the turn; on your upkeep, turn Vesuvan Shapeshifter face down.
Repeat infinitely.
